newsitem.title: GERMANY: German group to study Lufthansa control.
newsitem.headline: German group to study Lufthansa control.

text.p: A work group of government officials and businessmen is studying how majority control of German airline Lufthansa AG can remain in German hands after full privatisation, a government ministry confirmed on Monday.

The Ministry for Transport in Bonn confirmed a news report the group would be examining how a majority stake in the airline could remain in German hands in the long-term without other European citizens or companies being disadvantaged.
The German state currently holds 35.68 percent of Lufthansa. A fixed date for the remaining share sell-off has not been fixed but is seen as more likely in 1997 than 1996.
